title: FreightOS Network Event Correction
description: The payload of a correction event. A correction is a LINEAGE STATEMENT relating an already-accepted fact to an already-accepted replacement fact; it never carries replacement content itself and never mutates the original. There is deliberately no correcting_authority field: the envelope's organization_id records on whose behalf the correction is asserted, and the journal's trusted accepted_by records the FreightOS acceptance principal, which together preserve the provenance layers without inventing delegation semantics that do not exist.

corrected_event_id.description: event_id of the already-accepted event this correction supersedes.

replacement_event_id.description: event_id of the already-accepted companion fact carrying the replacement truth.

reason.description: Why the original is being corrected. Human-readable; carries no machine semantics.

effective_at.description: When the correction takes effect in domain time. Not an acceptance timestamp.
